message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I’ll be honest—I was a bit caught off guard. But instead of fretting over the lack of power, I decided to make it a cozy event! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some snacks, and we settled into the living room, creating a little fortress of pillows and blankets. We played some board games by flashlight, and it turned into one of those evenings I’ll cherish. 

Sometimes, a little disruption can turn into a delightful memory. So, whether it’s a few power banks or a stash of lanterns, being prepared can help us find the silver lining in any situation. What’s your tip for making the best of a blackout? 🌟
